source: existing saved MBTA V3 bus-position snapshots and existing 30-segment route results

rules.spatial_rule_note: The 200 m threshold preserves the original declared first-pass gate. Passing it is necessary but not sufficient.
rules.backtrack_rule_note: 20 m is the existing HMM observation-noise sigma used as an engineering tolerance, not an MBTA accuracy guarantee. Sensitivity counts at 1, 5, 20 and 50 m are reported.
rules.speed_rule_note: 55 m/s preserves the pre-match segmentation ceiling; along-route speed is now checked separately and cannot be hidden by small lateral error.
rules.accuracy_limit: MBTA V3 vehicle positions expose no per-point horizontal-accuracy field in these saved responses. No source-certified positional accuracy is claimed.

denominator_note: 205 not selected, 2 selected route failures, and 28 returned paths are distinct states; 207 is not reported as one failure count.
semantics: route_returned and topology_valid do not imply observation_eligible; native fallback is evaluated by identical spatial and temporal rules.
